article.title: Succession when heir disqualified.
article.content: If any person is disqualified from inheriting any property under this Act, it shall devolve as if such person had died before the intestate.
article.html:
27Succession when heir disqualified.

Section 27 · Chapter II · General provisions relating to succession · page 11 of the Act

If any person is disqualified from inheriting any property under this Act, it shall devolve as if such person had died before the intestate.
